title: salaami jisne dare baaghe panjetan
body:
salaami jisne dare baaghe panjetan dekha
usi ne rouzae rizwaan ka chaman dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
salaami ran ke jo band'de ne pairahan dekha
Qaba ki teh me lapeta hua kafan dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha adu ne basaarat kidhar gayi hai imaam
mili na laash pisar ki tammaam ran dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
jawaan bete ki mayyat na tum ne pehchaani
ye kis ka naize pa sar hai ye kiska sar dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha yazeed ne poshaak isko pehnaado
phata hua jo sakina ka pairahan dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha ke qaak me mil jaaungi na pehnoongi
Pidar ke murde ko jungle me be kafan dekha
